prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1388; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the recording.
A: I'd rather not give my name on this one, just note that I was the driver of the vehicle.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Conroe, Texas. I was going through on a green light when another car came across from the side street.

Q: Which direction were you traveling?
A: I was heading straight through the intersection. The other vehicle was coming from my right and it hit the driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I saw a flash of movement, maybe a half second before it hit. I tried to brake but there wasn't time.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was. The airbag deployed and I got pushed toward the door.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or hospital afterward?
A: The ambulance took me to the emergency room. They X-rayed my arm and told me the wrist was fractured. I've got a cast on it now and I'm going to see an orthopedic specialist next week.

Q: Did anyone else in the car get hurt?
A: No, I was alone in the vehicle.

Q: Is there anything you want to add about the collision?
A: Only that I've been unable to work since it happened, since my job involves a lot of lifting and typing. I'm trying to keep track of every bill and receipt.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you about the documentation you mentioned.
A: Okay, thanks.
